name: Umami Analytics
description: Adds the Umami web-analytics tracking script to every page, with role- and path-based visibility controls.
project_description: Adds the Umami Analytics web statistics tracking system to your website by injecting the Umami tracker script on every page. Umami is a simple, self-hosted, privacy-focused, cookieless alternative to Google Analytics. The module injects the admin-configured script URL and website ID, with visibility rules by user role, by request path, and single- or multi-domain tracking. Branch 1.x is D9-only and frozen; 2.x targets D10/D11. Still beta: local JS caching and cron sync are stubbed out (@TODO), and there is no test coverage. Current release 2.0.0-beta4.
